title: Per-Invocation completeness ordering, stickiness and isolation
method: fault injection on the 1st report, on finalization, a duplicate report, and two independent invocations
observed: failure on first report leaves no complete association; a failed finalization append leaves the window OPEN; a duplicate identical report is IDEMPOTENT and not a failure; independent invocations do not share health; the ordinary single-identity path still yields CLOSED_CONSISTENT
expectedInvariant: the failure state becomes sticky before finalization; concurrent distinct Invocations cannot share health state
remainingUncertainty: none material; the durable marker is the authority and is per-invocation
